admission.justification: The compiled handover tests prove the parent condition for every parentable role, the leaf peer routes and every protected parentless/dashboard value, so no runtime behavior of another role is claimed.

applicability: Handover preparation for any role a parent started through the native role launcher.
conditions: The launch has a parent: the developerQuestions value routes every developer question to the parent's agent id with role_message, says what is held back and recommended, and never uses the own-chat sentence.
The role is Worker, Reviewer or Curator: ownerRelation also names the direct sibling seat routes in leafSeats.roleMessageArguments and sends no routine result to the parent.
exclusions: Unrelated Worker, Reviewer and Curator handover text and tool requests remain unchanged.
The six unrelated role/operation orientations change only the shared canonical role-name sentence.
Native parent identity and peer-seat ownership are not derived from display names.
